# fabric_resources (Data Source)

Fetch the FABRIC available resources model from the orchestrator or portal resources endpoint. Use this data source when you need the raw advertised topology or portal graph payload for planning and inspection.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fetch raw advertised resource data for two sites during a planned reservation
# window.
data "fabric_resources" "planned_window" {
  level         = 2
  force_refresh = true
  start_date    = "2026-06-15T14:00:00Z"
  end_date      = "2026-06-17T14:00:00Z"
  includes      = "RENC,UKY"
}

output "planned_resource_model" {
  value = data.fabric_resources.planned_window.model
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `end_date` (String) Availability end time in FABRIC or RFC3339 format. When omitted, FABRIC uses its default availability window.
- `excludes` (String) Comma-separated site codes to exclude, such as `RENC,UKY`.
- `force_refresh` (Boolean) Whether to bypass cached resource information. Defaults to `false`.
- `graph_format` (String) Portal resource graph format. When set, the provider calls the portal resources endpoint instead of the orchestrator resources endpoint.
- `includes` (String) Comma-separated site codes to include, such as `RENC,UKY`.
- `level` (Number) Resource detail level to request from FABRIC. Defaults to `1`.
- `start_date` (String) Availability start time in FABRIC or RFC3339 format. When omitted, FABRIC uses its default availability window.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic data source identifier assigned by the provider.
- `model` (String) Opaque resource model returned by FABRIC and assigned by the provider after lookup.
